audit.address: 7660 Maltby Rd. East, Puslinch, Ontario N0B 2J0 (marketed as Guelph)
audit.expected_layout: 27 holes / three executive-length nines: Valley, Pines, Lakes (per victoriaparkgolf.com)
audit.headline: Victoria Park Valley exists in OSM ONLY as a single untagged-except-leisure=golf_course outline polygon (way 353716100). There are ZERO golf=* features of any kind inside it. Nothing importable.

boundary.note: Untouched since 2015. v2 was a pure geometry repair, not a survey. The polygon is a crude 18-node Bing trace of the property outline; no name, no addr, no website, no holes=27, no sport=golf.

feature_counts_inside_facility.note: Counting zero is the finding. Both the Overpass mirror and the live OSM API agree.

per_hole_table.note: Empty by necessity — there is not a single golf=hole way anywhere inside or within 2 km of the Victoria Park Valley boundary. No ref, par, or handicap data exists to tabulate.

nines_identification.reason: Cannot be determined from OSM: there are no hole ways to cluster by way-ID series or geography, and no changesets touching golf features on this site. Valley / Pines / Lakes exist only in the club's own marketing, not in OSM.
nines_identification.duplicate_ref_risk_when_mapped: HIGH. When a mapper does survey this site they will almost certainly number each nine ref=1..9 independently (that is what OSM convention and every comparable 27-hole site does). importOverpass.ts keys holes with holeLineByNumber.set(ref, f) in a plain Map, so the third nine surveyed would silently overwrite the first two and yield a 9-hole Frankenstein course. Guard against this BEFORE importing Victoria Park Valley.

non_golf_features_inside_boundary.method: Point-in-polygon of every way centroid from the live OSM API map call against way 353716100's geometry.
non_golf_features_inside_boundary.parser_impact: The 6 water polygons + 1 stream WOULD be picked up by isExpandedWaterFeature(), but nearestHoleNumber() returns null when holeLineList is empty, so `if (!nearest) continue` drops all of them. None of these ponds carries golf=water_hazard, and none of the buildings carries golf=clubhouse.

simulated_import_result.boundary_match: MISS — features.find(leisure=golf_course && name) fails (no name tag); fallback features.find(landuse=grass && name) also fails (zero landuse=grass in the bbox).

simulated_import_result.conclusion: A completely empty, unusable, unlocatable 18-hole shell for a facility that actually has 27 holes.

gaps_ordered_by_import_impact: Nothing golf-specific is mapped at all: 0 golf=hole, 0 golf=green, 0 golf=fairway, 0 golf=tee, 0 golf=bunker, 0 golf=rough, 0 golf=water_hazard inside way 353716100. All 27 holes need surveying from scratch before any import is possible.

The only boundary, way 353716100, has NO name tag (its entire tag set is leisure=golf_course), so importOverpass.ts finds no boundary at all and the course lands as 'Imported Course' with location=null. Add name=Victoria Park Valley Golf Club (plus holes=27, sport=golf, addr, website).

27 holes across three nines means refs WILL collide: number the ways ref=1..27 in a single sequence, or teach the parser to namespace by nine, before importing. As tagged today there is nothing to collide, but the trap is unavoidable the moment someone maps Valley/Pines/Lakes as 1-9 each.

No golf=hole centerlines means every green/tee/fairway/bunker added later would be orphaned — the parser matches features to holes geometrically off the centerlines. Survey centerlines FIRST, tee->green, open ways, with ref= and par=.
No handicap=<1-18> and no par= exist anywhere on site, so stroke index is unavailable and every hole would silently default to par 4.

The 6 ponds and 1 stream inside the property (ways 1427151546-51, 39881196) carry natural=water / waterway=stream but no golf=water_hazard, and are dropped entirely today because there are no centerlines to attach them to.
No golf=tee polygons exist, therefore no teebox= colour tags — the club's multiple tee decks are entirely unrepresented and would all import as indistinguishable 'Tee' even after tees are added.

Do not confuse this site with unnamed way 39872928 2.9 km north — that is the sister club Victoria Park EAST (18 holes, fully mapped, refs 1-18, par missing on holes 7 and 12). Its boundary is also unnamed, so a loose bbox export will import East under the wrong name.
